plain: Belonging to ordinary civil life and government, not to the church

webster.text: Pertaining to this present world, or to things not spiritual or holy; relating to things not immediately or primarily respecting the soul, but the body; worldly.

more.text: Coming once in a century; as a secular year.

example.quote: Torrents of blood have been spilt in the old world, by vain attempts of the secular arm, to extinguish Religious discord, by proscribing all difference in Religious opinion.
example.cite: James Madison, Memorial and Remonstrance Against Religious Assessments, c. June 20, 1785
